## v0.5.33: Git sync finds its token, and memory tasks leave no empty conversations / Git 同步能找到它的令牌，记忆任务不再留下空会话

Fixes two reported bugs and documents how the desktop app updates from older releases, [#437](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/437)–[#441](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/441).

- Git sync over HTTPS finds its token on a computer whose Git configuration names a user for the host or turns on `credential.useHttpPath`, as Git Credential Manager setups do, where it used to say "Needs credentials" although you were signed in. gitee.com gets the token under `oauth2`; every other host keeps `x-access-token`, and a host that wants another user name takes it in the address. When the host rejects the credential, the page says which one (#441, #408).
- Memory tasks that run outside a conversation no longer leave empty Untitled conversations under Ungrouped in the DSH sidebar or in the ACP session list (#438, #435).
- The documentation gives the desktop app's route from 0.5.30 and earlier on DSH 0.2.1: uninstall dsh-mnemon on the Plugins page and add it again as `dsh-mnemon@<version>`; memory and settings stay (#437, #433, #436).
- The READMEs end with the star history and a License section (#439, #440).

修复两个报告的问题，并写明桌面版如何从较早的版本更新，[#437](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/437)–[#441](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/441)。

- 电脑上的 Git 配置为主机指定了用户名或开启了 `credential.useHttpPath`（Git Credential Manager 的设置就是这样）时，通过 HTTPS 的 Git 同步以前会在已登录的情况下仍提示「需要凭据」，现在能找到令牌。gitee.com 改用 `oauth2`，其余主机仍用 `x-access-token`，需要其他用户名的主机可在地址中写明。主机拒绝凭据时，页面会说明被拒的是哪一个（#441，#408）。
- 在对话之外运行的记忆任务不再在 DSH 侧边栏的「未分组」下或 ACP 会话列表中留下空的「未命名」会话（#438，#435）。
- 文档写明了在 DSH 0.2.1 的桌面版中从 0.5.30 及更早版本更新的方法：在插件页卸载 dsh-mnemon，再以 `dsh-mnemon@<版本>` 重新添加，记忆与设置都会保留（#437，#433，#436）。
- 中英文 README 以 Star 历史与许可证章节收尾（#439、#440）。

The Starter advances to **0.5.33**; the other 17 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration. An earlier dsh-mnemon refuses a saved Git sync address that names a user, so remove the name before going back to one.

Starter 升至 **0.5.33**，其余 17 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。较早的 dsh-mnemon 会拒绝已保存的、写明用户名的 Git 同步地址，退回较早版本前请先去掉地址中的用户名。

Use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. That works from 0.5.31 and later on every supported DSH, and on DSH 0.2.0 also from 0.5.19 in the WebUI and from 0.5.22 in the desktop app. Older installations, including 0.5.30 and earlier on DSH 0.2.1, update once by hand: quit DSH, install the exact version, then start DSH again:

使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH。0.5.31 及更高版本在所有受支持的 DSH 上都可以这样更新；在 DSH 0.2.0 上，网页从 0.5.19 起、桌面版从 0.5.22 起也可以。更早的安装，包括 DSH 0.2.1 上的 0.5.30 及更早版本，需要手动更新一次：请退出 DSH，安装精确版本，再启动 DSH：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.33
```

In the desktop app, uninstall dsh-mnemon on the Plugins page, add it again with **Add plugin** as `dsh-mnemon@0.5.33`, then quit the app completely and open it again; memory and settings stay.

桌面版请在插件页**卸载** dsh-mnemon，再通过**添加插件**以 `dsh-mnemon@0.5.33` 重新安装，然后完全退出并重新打开应用；记忆与设置都会保留。
